svg.title: Server <-> Client Sequence Diagram (QNX: QNX Dispatch)

g.text: Server <-> Client Sequence Diagram (QNX: QNX Dispatch)
The Unix Domain counterpart is in server_client_sequence_linux.puml.
Both platforms expose the same public API.
The resource manager connect handler runs on the engine thread:
QnxDispatchServer creates its own ServerConnection, using the
engine directly - not the abstract ISharedResourceEngine.
ConnectCallback(connection) invoked; server app returns UserData,
Delivers the message through the resource manager,
Sends the reply through the resource manager
Sends the reply through the resource manager
Sends the notification through the resource manager
The server detects the disconnect and tears
